reasoning: On the season so far the Rockets are the stronger team; with home court the Rockets start about 10 points better, in a game of about 229 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 2 points towards the Rockets.
No psychological spot stands out for either team.
Bottom line: the Rockets win 83 times in 100, by about 12; most games like this end between 203 and 251 total points.
